limitations: The classification assumes integers a,b>=2, one nonnegative altered edge weight g>=0, all other cross-edge weights one, no onsite potentials, and infinite-time Cesaro averaging. Signed couplings, multiple defects, Laplacian dynamics and finite-time behavior are not covered. Broader unlocated spectral results could overlap.
scientific_integrity: The statement and proof concern a real symmetric weighted adjacency Hamiltonian. The Cesaro limit is analyzed using its full distinct-eigenvalue projectors, including repeated eigenvalues. Finite exact-arithmetic and spectral calculations corroborate rather than establish the unrestricted theorem. No claim of independently certified novelty or mathematical verification is made.
title: Exact average-mixing rank of a complete bipartite quantum network with one defective bond
